processing: Region bounds transformed into each source CRS by GDAL; only that window is read (HTTP range requests for remote files).
HiRISE 1 m DTM block-averaged (GDAL 'average') onto the 5 m local grid; cells with no HiRISE data filled from the CTX 20 m DTM (cubic).
Fine slope: slope of the native 1 m HiRISE DTM (ground-corrected for the equirectangular x stretch), third-quartile (GDAL q3) resample per 5 m cell.
Heights stored relative to datum_offset_m so the 3D scene stays near the origin; true elevation = height + datum_offset_m.
HiRISE 25 cm orthoimage area-averaged to 4096 x 4096 (0.49 m/px) and contrast-stretched (0.5-99.5 percentile). Grayscale, not colour.
THEMIS day-IR mosaic resampled (bilinear) to 64 x 64 for a display layer; values are 8-bit brightness, not calibrated temperature.
Mars 2020 traverse, waypoints and Ingenuity flights (NASA/JPL MMGIS GeoJSON) projected into the local frame; rover elevations checked against the HiRISE terrain.
Mars 2020 traverse, waypoints and Ingenuity flights (NASA/JPL MMGIS GeoJSON) projected into the local frame; rover elevations checked against the HiRISE terrain.

Surroundings: 80 km square of the Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM (decimated, bilinear) and orthoimage (area-averaged) in the same local frame; gaps outside the mosaic smoothly filled; orthoimage colour-mapped with the same ramp as the HiRISE ground.

surround.filled_note: Areas outside the CTX mosaic: heights smoothly interpolated, imagery a flat neutral tone.
